explanation: I searched Mathlib for a power-series analogue of "C ϖ divides x iff the reduction mod ϖ is zero". I found only the polynomial and multivariate-polynomial versions: Polynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff and MvPolynomial.C_dvd_iff_map_hom_eq_zero. Mathlib has no PowerSeries counterpart. PowerSeries.map_eq_zero is about division semirings and doesn't apply. I also found no PowerSeries lemma about the kernel of PowerSeries.map, or about coefficients in an ideal, that gives this result in a short derivation.
